meta.purpose: Design specs for 9 new site3d invitation templates, derived from Pinterest reference screenshots. Colors and photos must be original — do not replicate the reference images pixel-for-pixel, only the structural/mood direction.

alreadyBuilt.note: A 10th reference (Kyrgyz national style) was already implemented as components/invite-families/Kyrgyz.tsx + catalog entry id 'kyial'. Use that file as the concrete pattern example — same import style, same use of Field/SlotPhoto/CanvasText/Reveal/RsvpForm/WishesCard, same section-by-section layout.

architecture.familyComponent: Create components/invite-families/<Name>.tsx exporting function <Name>Family({ kit }: { kit: LayoutKit }). 'use client' at top. Follow the section-splitting pattern used in components/invite-families/Mauve.tsx (self-contained HeroSection/CountdownSection/etc sub-functions) for any template with custom RSVP fields, or the simpler single-return pattern used in Kyrgyz.tsx/Traditional.tsx when the standard RsvpForm/WishesCard components are enough.
registerSteps: lib/inviteFamilies.ts — add the new key to the INVITE_FAMILIES const array, and add 'catalogId: familyKey' to FAMILY_BY_TEMPLATE
lib/types.ts — add the new key to the TemplateStyle.pageLayout union type

components/invite-families/index.tsx — import the new Family component; add 'if (family === "key") return <XFamily kit={kit} />;' inside FamilyLayout; add a matching thumbnail case inside FamilyThumb (small preview card shown in the template catalog grid — hero photo + names, ~4 lines of JSX, see existing cases for style)

lib/templates.ts — add one object to the seedTemplates array: { id, name: {ky, ru}, designer: 'Chakyru Studio', format: 'site3d', eventTypes: [...], featured: true, priceSom: 1, style: style(bg, panel, accent, text, muted, { overlay, pageBg, pageLayout: 'familyKey' }) }. Optionally add a 'canvas' object with default names/message like the 'kyial' and 'mauve' entries do.
app/globals.css — add '[data-family="familyKey"] .site3d-sticky button { border-radius: Npx; }' matching the button corner style of the design (0 = sharp, 4-6 = soft rectangle, 999 = pill).

sharedHelpers.components/invite-families/shared.ts: coupleNames(), mapsEmbedUrl(), pad(), programItems(), addHour(), monthLabel() — reuse, don't reinvent
sharedHelpers.components/invite-families/Ornaments.tsx: per-family decorative SVGs live here (dividers, corner flourishes). Add new ones here if the design needs a unique motif.
sharedHelpers.components/invite-families/Icons.tsx / f: generic line icons for program timeline (rings, plate, glasses, cake, music, pin, cutlery, sparkle, note, arch) — reuse these before drawing new ones
sharedHelpers.components/invite-families/Reveal.tsx: wraps a section for a scroll-in fade animation; pass instant={!!kit.onChange}
sharedHelpers.components/invite-families/RsvpForm.tsx: generic name+status(yes/no/maybe)+submit form. To use it: add the new family key to its 'tone' union type and add matching input/optionCls/submit Tailwind strings to its three style maps.
sharedHelpers.components/invite-families/Wishes.tsx: generic guest-wishes carousel card. Same extension pattern as RsvpForm (tone union + title/card style maps).
sharedHelpers.note_on_custom_rsvp: If a design needs extra RSVP fields (guest count, drink preference, dress-code confirmation etc — see 'rsvpExtra' per template below), don't extend the generic RsvpForm — build a bespoke RSVPSection function inside the family file itself, following components/invite-families/Mauve.tsx's RSVPSection as the template (it calls addRsvp() and addWish() from @/lib/store directly).

architecture.fontsRule: Do not register new Google Fonts / next/font entries. Pick the closest existing font class per template (mapped below per template as 'fonts').
architecture.colorRule: Each family hardcodes its own literal hex colors inside its component (this matches the existing codebase convention — the catalog 'style' object mainly drives the browse-page thumbnail background, not the live page). Use the palette given per template below as the literal Tailwind arbitrary-value colors (bg-[#xxxxxx] etc).
architecture.globalCoverNote: The envelope-opening intro screen (Site3D.tsx Cover component) is shared across ALL templates and already exists — do not rebuild an envelope/intro animation per family. Family components only render what appears AFTER the envelope opens.
architecture.afterBuilding: Run npx tsc --noEmit and npx eslint on changed files before committing. Commit to a feature branch, push, open a PR.
